# DigiLift AI

> DigiLift AI is an AI, technology and marketing agency serving businesses and organizations across the United States. We take a business from the product it runs on to the customers it wins, with AI powering every step.

## Services (one end-to-end pipeline)

1. App Development: websites, portals and custom software built around how an organization works.
2. Digital Marketing: targeted campaigns, content and creative, including Meta and search advertising.
3. Lead Generation: capturing and qualifying every inquiry automatically.
4. Customer Acquisition: follow-up, booking and missed-lead recovery that turn leads into customers.
5. Growth Strategy: analytics, reporting and ongoing optimization.

AI-powered solutions (AI assistants, workflow automation, data processing) run underneath every step.

## Work

- SABCVA Alumni & Intern Platform: an AI-powered portal with AI smart-matching for the South Asian Business Council of Virginia.
- Empower Virginia 2026: a Meta ad campaign for SABCVA's networking event and CEO summit; 600+ tickets sold.
